messages:
Priya (Contractor): Hi all 1 I start tomorrow and have a quick question: my client contract forbids enrolling their machines in third-party MDM. I was given a company laptop image earlier but it's shipping late. Can I use my personal Mac and avoid MDM, or is the hardened VM the only option? Also saw the phishing training note 55 are contractors included?
People Ops: Welcome Priya! :wave: Contractors are generally expected to use company-managed devices. If that's not possible due to client rules, we can provision the monitored guest VM or a cloud dev box. Please file the access request form and note "client restriction" so Security can approve.
Marta (IT): Quick technical note: if you absolutely need to avoid enrolling your personal device we *cannot* grant persistent KMS or production credentials to that device. We can provide a short-lived dev VM or remote desktop into a locked-down instance. For the company image we can also run expedited shipping; DM me shipping address if you want.
Priya (Contractor): Thanks Marta. If I request the guest VM, will I still receive the phishing sims? My client asked us not to click any external links during their contract period.
Evan (Security): Good question. Phish sims are applied by org unit and role. Contractors on guest VM still receive sims because we want to test access/behavior. If the client contract prevents interaction with external emails, we can temporarily exempt you from the sim window for the duration of the contract, but we require a written justification and the contract clause. Please DM me the clause or ask your PM to upload it to the access request. Exemptions are time-boxed.
phish-sim-bot: New hire phish simulation window upcoming: 2026-04-05 -> 2026-04-07 UTC. Opt-out/exemption requests must be submitted by 2026-04-03. (automated message)
Priya (Contractor): Got it. I'll attach the contract clause in the access request and ask for the guest VM + short dev creds. One practical ask: can you confirm how to check the MDM enrollment status on macOS in case I end up enrolling the company laptop when it arrives?
Marta (IT): Run `sudo profiles status -type enrollment` or check System Settings -> Profiles. If the device is enrolled you'll see the Redwood MDM profile and the management certificate. If profile install fails, send the output of `profiles -I -F ~/Downloads/redwood_mdm.mobileconfig` and we can debug.
Priya (Contractor): Perfect. I'll open the access request now. Thanks everyone!
People Ops: Nice. Ping here when you submit the form so we can triage quickly. :rocket:
